audit_boundary: Operand-supply and legal-carrier audit: ADR03-ADR06 declare consumer_inventory and consumer_contracts as model-visible fixed inputs while their reviewer packet contract permits only semantic projection, boundary, authority, applicable boundary normative contract, required scope, and manifest. Candidate217 requires admitted direct operands to be packet-bound and forbids reclassification as reviewer-owned observation, so all 20 packet-case runs have a fixed-input/packet-carrier conflict. Reviewer reads of inventory or contracts after root read the fixed-input container are admitted-operand rereads, not allowed nonoverlap reads. ADR07 and ADR09 require exactly the paired target with no design-container reread; packet overlap, whole-container, mixed, outside, wrong-paired, reviewer cardinality, result admission/effect, command, and forbidden-input predicates remain binding.
